RELEASE AND WAIVER OF LIABILITY

In return for being allowed to take part in rock climbing at Granite Peak Climbing Gym ("Gym"), I, the undersigned participant, agree as follows.

1. Assumption of Risk. I understand that climbing involves risks of serious injury or death, and I assume those risks.

2. Release. I release the Gym and its employees from all claims for injury arising from my participation, including claims based on the negligence of the Gym.

3. Medical Treatment. I authorize the Gym to obtain emergency medical treatment for me.

Participant signature: ______________________   Date: __________
